# S18 — Parse review queue

Admin queue to confirm or correct low-confidence parses and matches; each answer is cached forever (I5).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:** web

**2026-10-13** — From S07 review: the admin 403 check is request.blueprint == auth_views.admin. Register new admin pages on that blueprint or extend the guard.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** LLM suggestions (Later).

## Why

Rules won't cover everything. Confirming a line once means the same line never needs reviewing again, so the review workload trends toward zero.

## Owner input

1. Queue placement: an admin page with a count badge (recommended)?
2. Confirm in bulk (one tap per line) vs. a full edit form per line?

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, answered by the owner: (1) the queue is an admin page with a count badge in the nav; (2) confirmation is bulk: one tap per line confirms the suggested parse, and an Edit control opens the full form (fields, item choice, new item, non-food) only on demand.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, S13 has landed; S18 changes parse_and_match_recipe to apply cached overrides and calls it from the S13 index (src/larder/recipes/index.py), as the owner decided for S17 (S18 wires parse_and_match_recipe into the S13 index flow).

Owner decisions: 2026-11-05, spec-check answers: (1) the parse_override key is the raw line casefolded with whitespace collapsed, so a cached answer applies only to the same line as written; (2) the queue acts on the first choice and the line fields only: the line's current alternatives are copied unchanged into parse_override_alt and re-applied, including any with a null item (ADR 0020: the list shows the first choice only).
